key_insight: For the studied Minimum Vertex Cover instance, QAOA and FALQON follow distinct entanglement and coherence trajectories as they approach optimal solutions.
engineering_relevance: Tracking quantum resources across circuit depth can inform comparisons of optimization strategies for near-term quantum devices.
method: Apply QAOA and FALQON to Minimum Vertex Cover.
Optimize auxiliary circuits to identify closest resource-free states using the Bures metric and Uhlmann’s theorem.
Quantify entanglement and coherence without full quantum state tomography.
evidence_signal: QAOA shows an early, pronounced entanglement peak and residual coherence, while FALQON shows a lower, later entanglement peak and smoothly decreasing coherence.
watch_item: Results concern one problem instance; broader generality and auxiliary-circuit optimization costs remain to be established.
paper_title: Resource Analysis of Quantum Optimization Algorithms via Variational Methods
